evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 月地云居
evidence.excerpt_zh: 山髙水長之北度橋由山口入梵刹一區為月地雲居殿五楹前殿方式四面各五楹後樓上下各七楹月地雲居之東為法源樓又東為静室西度橋折而北為劉猛將軍廟（圓明園册）臣等謹按月地雲居四十景之一額為皇上御書山門額曰清浄地前殿額曰妙證無聲後樓簷額曰蓮花法藏與法源樓静室諸額皆御書
evidence.summary: North of 山高水長, through a gap in the hills: a Buddhist precinct, 月地雲居, with a five-bay hall, a square front hall of five bays per side and a seven-bay two-storey rear tower. 法源樓 and a 静室 to the east, 劉猛將軍廟 to the north-west.

evidence.title: 静室
evidence.locator: v2 p.157, under 月地云居; source ref 10-522
evidence.excerpt_zh: 诸动本乎静，耽静即动时。寂寂物尽忘，幢幢朋从思。静固我所愿，其如酬万几。应而有不纷，澄而非无为。哲人方能是，企焉吾将希。
evidence.summary: Poem 静室 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1769, filed by the editors under 月地云居.

evidence.title: 静室
evidence.locator: v2 p.157, under 月地云居; source ref 6-368
evidence.excerpt_zh: 心静事不淆，枢机蕴一室。养正勿偏敧，内省涵宥密。储才佐邦家，用舍戒轻率。官民果相亲，上下咸安谧。此愿岂能孚，予衷勉求实。交泰普大廷，治功渐详悉。
evidence.summary: Poem 静室 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1817, filed by the editors under 月地云居.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum and Historical Photographs of China; today's photographs on Commons.
